vi: My dream was so glorious I didn't want to wake up...how I soared around paradise! Let me hold onto that feeling.

en: The most sumptuous, succulent banquet was laid before me in my dream last night. I could eat forever, my appetite was infinite!
vi: The most sumptuous, succulent banquet was laid before me in my dream last night. I could eat forever, my appetite was infinite!

en: I was chewing this delicious, roasted arm, then I realised it was mine, and it was still attached! But I couldn't stop, I was ravenous...
vi: I was chewing this delicious, roasted arm, then I realised it was mine, and it was still attached! But I couldn't stop, I was ravenous...

en: I bathed in asses milk and rose petals. Rising from the steaming vessel, handmaidens clothed me in silk and fed me sweetmeats. Alas, just a dream...
vi: I bathed in asses milk and rose petals. Rising from the steaming vessel, handmaidens clothed me in silk and fed me sweetmeats. Alas, just a dream...

en: I dreamed of a solitary cliffside hermitage, where I sat for many hours on the cold floor, staring out at the crashing Atlantic waves. I woke refreshed.
vi: I dreamed of a solitary cliffside hermitage, where I sat for many hours on the cold floor, staring out at the crashing Atlantic waves. I woke refreshed.

en: I dreamed of a glorious battle, where we spilled a river of blood and fought until the sun rose upon our victory. I was brutal, and heroic!
vi: I dreamed of a glorious battle, where we spilled a river of blood and fought until the sun rose upon our victory. I was brutal, and heroic!

en: I had one of those dreams where your teeth fall out, and you spend ages looking for them. Then you realise you are at the market, stark naked.
vi: I had one of those dreams where your teeth fall out, and you spend ages looking for them. Then you realise you are at the market, stark naked.

en: Paralysed as the water rose about me, I knew I was going to drown, in the dark. Something squatted on my chest, laughing. I woke gasping for breath...
vi: Paralysed as the water rose about me, I knew I was going to drown, in the dark. Something squatted on my chest, laughing. I woke gasping for breath...

en: I was at an exotic banquet. The food came alive, writhing, scrabbling, and slithering about. I gagged, raising a spoonful to my mouth...then I awoke!
vi: I was at an exotic banquet. The food came alive, writhing, scrabbling, and slithering about. I gagged, raising a spoonful to my mouth...then I awoke!

en: I was forced to sleep on a bed of nails at the bottom of a well, then put in the stocks and pelted with filth by peasants! Ugh! What a nightmare!
vi: I was forced to sleep on a bed of nails at the bottom of a well, then put in the stocks and pelted with filth by peasants! Ugh! What a nightmare!

en: I am become an animated charnel house, rattling bones and chapless skulls mounted upon my own vital flesh.
vi: I am become an animated charnel house, rattling bones and chapless skulls mounted upon my own vital flesh.

en: Wearing the Items of the Dead
vi: Wearing the Items of the Dead

en: It's ill waiting for dead men's shoes, they say. But if an item's not worn out, I suppose I must use it.
vi: It's ill waiting for dead men's shoes, they say. But if an item's not worn out, I suppose I must use it.

en: If I don another's skin, what aspect of them am I keeping alive? I look fearsome, but fear for my own soul.
vi: If I don another's skin, what aspect of them am I keeping alive? I look fearsome, but fear for my own soul.

en: Being around human leather makes my skin crawl. I can't pretend I like it.
vi: Being around human leather makes my skin crawl. I can't pretend I like it.

en: The sight of human leather items
vi: The sight of human leather items

en: It's surely sacriledge to use human body parts. Are these things haunted?
vi: It's surely sacriledge to use human body parts. Are these things haunted?

en: To be honest, I'm lucky that I'm still standing. Plenty of others haven't made it this far.
vi: To be honest, I'm lucky that I'm still standing. Plenty of others haven't made it this far.

en: Life isn't easy. But I get by with what I have. Mustn't grumble.
vi: Life isn't easy. But I get by with what I have. Mustn't grumble.

en: We all need a little comfort in our lives, don't we? I'm not talking about anything fancy.
vi: We all need a little comfort in our lives, don't we? I'm not talking about anything fancy.

en: I've worked hard, so I reckon I deserve some of the finer things in life.
vi: I've worked hard, so I reckon I deserve some of the finer things in life.

en: I'm not ashamed to say that I want the very best. I'm worth it.
vi: I'm not ashamed to say that I want the very best. I'm worth it.
